overall_notes: I used only the supplied data, without tools or browsing; my roster and role knowledge may be stale for November 2026. I favor a small shortlist because these are unverified proxy lines, recent hit streaks can overstate predictive strength, and one-sided sportsbook prices cannot establish no-vig probabilities. Confidence follows your outcome definition, so cuts remain near 50% when the evidence supports passing more strongly than predicting a miss.

votes.reasoning: The recent unders support the direction, but a 7.2 average against 7.5 leaves little cushion against Chicago's stated pace. Additional minutes could offset the recent trend, and -154 alone does not establish the quoted fair probability. An 8.5 line or stronger evidence of reduced creation would change my mind.

Missing backup centers helps playing time more directly than shot share, and the depleted opponent could make the game uncompetitive early. A materially tighter spread or a 12.5 line would change my mind.
